title: Minecraft XP
blurb: The Minecraft XP orb sound — that satisfying bubbling collection noise as experience streams into you. It's one of gaming's most quietly perfect audio rewards: soft, plentiful, and endlessly re-triggerable. Play it whenever you learn something, finish a task, or want to make any mundane achievement feel like progress toward enchanting.
origin: The experience-orb collection sound from Minecraft.
